items.title: No multi-clause list comprehensions or `std.math.choose` for small exact binomials
items.general_fix: Support multi-clause comprehensions (`for ... , ...`) and add exact `std.math.choose(n: Int, k: Int) -> Int`.

items.title: `List.sorted(by:)` / `List.sort(by:)` allocates temporary key/index vectors and indirect-sorts
items.general_fix: Lower `sort(by:)` with a cheap/stateless key (such as `ByAngle`) to direct in-place sorting without allocating parallel key/index buffers, and allow type constructors as first-class functions.

items.title: No cyclic two-pointer span helper (`cyclic_span`)
